samples.xml_description:
Implement a 64-bit ripple carry adder with 16-bit registers to enable 4 pipeline stages. Clock input. Active low reset signal. Enable signal for addition operation. 64-bit input operand A. 64-bit input operand B. 65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb. Output enable signal. 4 1-bit input enable signal register. 1-bit carry-in signal register. 64-bit sum register.

Implement a 64-bit ripple carry adder with 16-bit registers to enable 4 pipeline stages.

When the (result) and the (o_en) must be asserted in the same time, at the same clock (clk) cycle.

Use the following template:

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (!rst_n) begin i_en_reg <= 4'b0; carry_in_reg <= 4'b0; sum_reg <= 64'b0; end else begin i_en_reg <= {i_en_reg[2:0], i_en}; carry_in_reg <= {carry_in_reg[2:0], 1'b0}; sum_reg <= {sum_reg[55:0], adda[15:0] + addb[15:0] + carry_in_reg[0]}; end end
